title: Map Sum Pairs
description:
Design a map that allows you to map string keys to integer values and return the sum of the values whose keys have a given prefix.

Implement the `MapSum` class:
- `MapSum()` initializes the `MapSum` object.
- `void insert(String key, int val)` inserts the `key-val` pair into the map. If `key` already existed, the original key-value pair is overridden with the new value.
- `int sum(String prefix)` returns the sum of all the pairs' values whose key starts with `prefix`. If no key starts with `prefix`, return `0`.
constraints: key and prefix consist only of lowercase English letters.
At most 1000 calls will be made to insert and sum.
hints: Store a running prefix sum at every node of a trie so sum(prefix) only needs to walk along the characters of prefix in O(L) time.
Because insert can overwrite an existing key, also maintain a hash map recording each key's latest value.
On insert(key, val), compute delta = val - oldVal (with oldVal = 0 if new), update the map, and add delta to every trie node along key.

examples.explanation: After inserting ("apple", 3), sum("ap") is 3. After inserting ("app", 2), both "apple" and "app" start with "ap", giving 3 + 2 = 5.
Overwriting "apple" from 3 to 5 updates the prefix sum for "ap" from 5 to 7, while sum("apple") returns 5.
